chunks: Verily you will have no hunger or nakedness there,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran promise regarding hunger and nakedness in Paradise for the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this promise of freedom from hunger and nakedness is often interpreted not merely as physical sustenance but as the ultimate removal of all worldly anxieties and spiritual deficiencies, reflecting the complete satisfaction (Rida) of the soul. It underscores the divine guarantee that the Prophet and the Imams, as the perfect servants, will experience the purest form of comfort in Jannah, free from any trace of need or vulnerability.
